note: Fight it out (brief 018 §5), the loud twin of loud: the police never break, so once the response unit is down the Scout and Tech close on the officers at the café wall and the cell downs them all; then the three board after the Enforcer (the seal clock runs: anyone left standing would be captured). No contact. The Tech and the Enforcer run (free once the run is loud; before it, noticed). Once the guard is shot the Scout, Fixer and Tech run to cover by the car and draw; the Enforcer brings Vale to the car under their cover.
